title: Dialogue menus renumber after every pick with no warning. Mid-conversation with the smith at The Forge, after asking 'the smith's trade' I picked option 3 intending the still-listed 'your apprentice', but the menu had shrunk and 3 was now 'leave her to the forge' — it ended the conversation early and I had to re-open it to actually ask about the apprentice.
